offering_description.value: Ryan Specialty places specialty insurance for businesses and institutions through retail insurance brokers. It also designs and underwrites insurance and reinsurance programs under authority delegated by carriers.

primary_products.value: commercial property insurance; casualty insurance; professional liability insurance; employer medical stop-loss insurance; specialty reinsurance

primary_services.value: wholesale insurance brokerage; delegated policy underwriting and binding; insurance program design and administration; reinsurance underwriting management

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail insurance agencies and brokerages, insurers and reinsurers, and employers buying coverage through brokers

end_markets.value: commercial property and casualty insurance; professional liability insurance; employer health benefits; reinsurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: insurance placement commissions and carrier payments for managing underwriting programs; service fees: brokerage and policy administration fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: matches risks submitted by retail brokers with coverage from specialty insurers; distributor: uses carrier capacity to offer specialty policies to retail agents under delegated binding authority; service provider: uses delegated authority to design, underwrite, and administer programs for insurers and reinsurers

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with operations in Canada, the United Kingdom, and continental Europe

specialization.value: related lines: wholesale brokerage, delegated binding, and underwriting management for specialty insurance, employer benefits, and reinsurance

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: retail insurance agents and brokers place coverage for their commercial clients; online: digital portals let retail agents quote and bind eligible policies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance producer and surplus lines licensing in the United States and Financial Conduct Authority oversight in the United Kingdom
